observations: VR registration uses nested layer/AGC texture descriptors, not pixel pointers.
Consumer calls SetParam then an explicit flip; engine polls its GPU marker but can continue after timeout without observed completion (see continuation).
Tracker query in this consumer uses a 32-byte input.
SetParamWithBuffer is distinct from SetParam; recorded layer strides differ (472 vs 328 bytes).
Size query returns two 64-bit values in RAX:RDX.
This implementation does not provide a working initialized VR runtime.

sources.author: frankea
observations: Author reports Horizon calibration rendering on local emulator modifications, not on a native replacement PS5 runtime.
HMD registration uses two entries per buffer and category 16; author did not observe the title directly flipping the HMD port.
Tracker query uses 48-byte parameters; result uses state/quality fields as well as pose.
Local fake behavior and example addresses do not establish portable ABI or 13.20 compatibility.

decision: Investigate process-local VR interface replacement plus virtual HMD registration/reprojection capture.
unresolved: Exact native 13.20 contracts and live bindings
